meta.title: Custom awarding rule typed into the Smart Awarding chat

args.goal: In the already-open Smart Awarding side panel, type a custom awarding rule or logic into the chat text box, click the blue send icon, and stop when an AI response visibly shows a suggested awarding plan with suggested vendor(s) and justification.

steps.note: Performs and observes the Smart Awarding chat interaction, including the generated response.
Confirms the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or malformed content.
